site.name: Tidewater Docs
site.tagline: Documentation for the Tidewater file sync tool

content.headline: Keep two folders the same, everywhere.
content.subheadline: A small, fast command line tool for syncing folders between machines. No account, no cloud.

features.title: Getting started
features.description: Install and run your first sync.

doc.name: Overview
doc.description: What Tidewater is and what it is for.
doc.content:
What Tidewater is and what it is for.

Before you begin

You need Tidewater 2.0 or later. Check with tidewater --version.

Steps

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the command below.
  3. Check the output.
tidewater sync ~/Documents /mnt/backup --watch

Options

FlagDefaultMeaning
--watchoffkeep running and sync on every change
--dry-runoffshow what would change

Note: a sync never deletes a file that changed on both sides; see Conflicts.

Next steps

  • Configuration
  • Conflicts
